title: Our-Island
description: A multi/cross-versional and diverse server network based on Velocity proxy.
body:
## 🌍 Welcome to the Our-Island Server Network 🌍
**✨ A multi-version, cross-version, and diverse server network based on Velocity Proxy.** Our server is built on **Velocity Proxy** ⚡, delivering a stable, flexible, and diverse Minecraft network for players of all kinds. Whether you enjoy **survival 🌲**, **creative building 🏗️**, or **fun minigames 🎮**, there is always something here for you. ### 🧩 What We Offer #### 🔄 Multi-Version / Cross-Version Support Our network supports multiple versions and cross-version connectivity, allowing more players to join easily and play together without being limited by version differences. #### 🎯 Diverse Game Modes Our server currently features a variety of game modes, including: * **🌲 Survival** — Gather resources, explore the world, build your base, and enjoy a long-term survival experience. * **🏗️ Creative** — Unleash your imagination and create anything you want, from simple homes to massive cities and unique builds. * **🎮 Minigames** — Jump into fast-paced and entertaining games for casual fun, competition, and social interaction. #### ⚡ Stable Network Experience Powered by **Velocity Proxy**, our server network is designed to provide smooth connections, efficient routing, and a better overall multiplayer experience. #### 🤝 Community and Growth We aim to build more than just a server. We want to create a welcoming community where players can **explore 🧭, build 🏰, compete 🏆, and have fun 🎉** together. We will continue improving the server, expanding content, and bringing new experiences to all our players. ### 🎯 Our Goal Our goal is to create a **multi-version, content-rich, and player-friendly server network** that combines **stability ⚙️, diversity 🌈, and fun 🎉**. No matter what type of player you are, there will always be a place for you here. ### 🚀 Join Us If you are looking for a server with **survival 🌲, creative 🏗️, minigames 🎮, and more**, we warmly welcome you to join our network and start your next adventure with us.
